name: Backdrop Image Carousel
description: Full-screen autoplay image carousel with a square framed card over a blurred, cross-fading copy of the same image as backdrop, a progress bar, a counter and prev/next buttons.
contents: Full-bleed backdrop of the current image
Square image card with autoplay progress bar
behavior: Advances automatically every autoPlayInterval ms and loops
Images cross-fade with a slight scale while the backdrop fades in sync
Progress bar restarts on every slide change, manual navigation resets the timer
editableByProps: Card width and backdrop opacity as Tailwind classes

needsCodeEdit.where: aspect-square class on the card div
duration-[1200ms] and duration-1000 classes on the backdrop and img elements

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and stays full-bleed with overflow hidden
Counter and button bar styling uses fixed white translucent tones
